name: Apar Inds.
why: Record quarterly profit, annual sales, annual profit
Profit breakout: +78% YoY and above the last 4 quarters
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Excellent (sales +29% YoY, profit +78% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) raised holding by 3.3 pts in a year
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 1.2 pts in a year
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 91% to 88% of sales)
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 80 to 85, inventory days 82 to 84 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Thin order book: only 0.4x annual sales
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
Promoter holding fell 2.4 pts in a year

order_book: The pending order book stands at around INR10,190 crores with an export proportion of 56.8%.
So if I look at our existing order backlog, that is now touching closer to INR10,000 crores.
guidance: Ramesh Iyer: And it's also, Amit, in line with the guidance that we give, about 10% to 11%, it's hovering around that particular number.
risks: Otherwise, this has been a fairly challenging quarter from an external perspective, given the impact of the U.S.
And there is only a certain time line to which a delay can be done as there are very stringent penalties for the overall delay in the project execution.
focus: So our strategy has been -- which we've spoken about very much in the past, that we focus on premium products in the domestic market and the standard product range, we would rather focus on the export markets.

about: Apar, founded by Mr. Dharmsinh D. Desai in 1958, is a market leader in India with a global presence. Contributing to India’s process of electrification it started from manufacturing power transmission cables to having three broad business segments, which are Conductors, Transformer and specialty oils (TSO), and Power/telecom Cables.
